name: bld6_pisano_two_pow_mul_five_pow_eq_six_mul_iff
informal: Uses Mathlib2.bld4_pisano_mul_of_coprime, Mathlib2.bld5_pisano_two_pow and Mathlib2.bld5_pisano_five_pow: π(2^(a+1)5^(b+1)) = lcm(3·2^a, 4·5^(b+1)) by the coprime-lcm rule and the two prime-power formulas; this equals 12·5^(b+1) for a ≤ 1 and 3·2^a·5^(b+1) for a ≥ 2, i.e. 6n, 3n, 3n/2 respectively — so the extremal ratio π(n) = 6n occurs exactly for a = 0 (n = 2·5^(b+1)).
